decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +1.0% and S&P 500 +0.5% marked a mild risk-on day. With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, we deployed into three top-scoring, multi-signal-confirmed names (FN, RVTY, AEHR) while keeping position sizes moderate since volume-surge confirmation was absent. No existing positions triggered stop-loss or profit-target exits, so all current holdings stay untouched.

market_education.summary_en: Markets drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, suggesting continued but not accelerating appetite for growth and tech names. There was no major single catalyst reported today — the move looks like steady follow-through buying rather than a reaction to a specific headline. Breadth across sectors (semiconductors, photonics, diagnostics) showing bullish technical setups points to a broad-based, if measured, risk-on tone.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和向上,納指升幅跑贏標普500指數,反映市場對科技及增長股的胃納持續但未見明顯加速。今日未見有重大單一消息主導市況,走勢更似是資金持續流入下的穩步上揚,而非對個別新聞的反應。半導體、光學通訊及診斷等多個板塊同時出現技術性走強訊號,顯示今次升市屬較廣泛但程度溫和的風險偏好情緒。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) bullish crossover happens when a stock's momentum line crosses above its signal line, often signaling that upward price momentum is building. Traders watch for this alongside other signals like RSI and price relative to moving averages to confirm a genuine trend rather than a brief blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: MACD(移動平均匯聚擴散指標)出現「黃金交叉」時,代表股價的動能線升穿訊號線,往往顯示上升動力正在增強。交易者通常會同時參考RSI及股價與移動平均線的關係等其他指標,以確認這是真正的升勢,而非短暫的波動。
